_comment: Curated UCI ML Repository datasets for the DS agent failure analysis benchmark.
_note: Uses ucimlrepo package (pip install ucimlrepo). Dataset IDs from the official UCI API.
_coverage: Targets gaps not covered by STRABLE/Kaggle/OpenML: time series, ordinal regression, classic benchmarks with known literature results.
_api: pip install ucimlrepo  —  no credentials required.

datasets.name: adult
datasets.notes: 48k rows; census data; income >50K; classic fairness benchmark — use if OpenML version unavailable

datasets.name: breast-cancer-wisconsin
datasets.notes: 569 rows; 30 cell nucleus features; malignant/benign

datasets.name: magic-gamma-telescope
datasets.notes: 19020 rows; 10 features; gamma vs hadron showers; physics experiment

datasets.name: default-of-credit-card-clients
datasets.notes: 30k rows; 23 features; credit default in Taiwan; imbalanced (~22%)

datasets.name: heart-failure-clinical
datasets.notes: 299 rows; 12 clinical features; survival prediction; small dataset

datasets.name: estimation-of-obesity-levels

datasets.name: dry-bean-dataset
